fields.description: 24-byte ROM title string copied to save offset 0 at init; first 3 EEPROM blocks verified against it at boot.
fields.evidence: FUN_08005104 copies 0x18 ROM bytes to save offset 0x00; FUN_080050a8 calls FUN_080056f8 which verifies EEPROM blocks 0-2 via FUN_08027618; baseline holds ASCII 'GOEMON NextGeneration'.
fields.name: game_title

fields.description: Slot 0 init/valid marker: first u16 of the 0x70-byte slot struct, zeroed by the slot init routine.
fields.evidence: FUN_08005678 writes *(u16*)slot+0 = 0 for each of 3 slots at save offsets 0x18/0x118/0x218 (stride 0x100); slot base mapped by FUN_08005670 ((id&0xff)*0x20+3 blocks).
fields.name: slot0_status

fields.description: Slot 0 gameplay payload: remaining 0x6E bytes of the checksummed slot struct (uninitialized 0xFF in a fresh save).
fields.evidence: FUN_08005678 fills the 0x70-byte slot at save offset 0x18 with 0xFF; FUN_08005788 sums 0x70 bytes for the stored checksum; FUN_08005260 loads the slot via FUN_080055ac (0x100 bytes at block (id&0xff)*0x20+3).
fields.name: slot0_save_data

fields.description: Slot 1 init/valid marker, mirror of slot 0 (save offset 0x118).
fields.evidence: FUN_08005678 inits 3 slots at stride 0x100 from save offset 0x18 via FUN_08005104 (buffer +0x40 words per slot); FUN_08005670 maps slot 1 to EEPROM block 0x23 (byte 0x118).
fields.name: slot1_status

fields.description: Slot 1 gameplay payload, mirror of slot 0 (0x118..0x188).
fields.evidence: Same init/load/checksum path as slot 0: FUN_08005678, FUN_08005260 via FUN_080055ac, byte-sum FUN_08005788 over 0x70 bytes stored at 0x188.
fields.name: slot1_save_data

fields.description: Slot 2 init/valid marker, mirror of slot 0 (save offset 0x218).
fields.evidence: FUN_08005678 inits 3 slots at stride 0x100 from save offset 0x18 via FUN_08005104; FUN_08005670 maps slot 2 to EEPROM block 0x43 (byte 0x218).
fields.name: slot2_status

fields.description: Slot 2 gameplay payload, mirror of slot 0 (0x218..0x288).
fields.evidence: Same init/load/checksum path as slot 0: FUN_08005678, FUN_08005260 via FUN_080055ac, byte-sum FUN_08005788 over 0x70 bytes stored at 0x288.
fields.name: slot2_save_data

fields.description: ROM build timestamp string stored in the file footer (first 0x14 bytes of the footer struct).
fields.evidence: FUN_080056a0 copies 0x15 ROM bytes (first 0x14 kept) to footer at save offset 0x318 (buffer +0xc6 words); baseline holds 'Dec  1 2001 23:00:58'.
fields.name: build_date

fields.description: Active-file flag in the footer struct: 0 after init, must be 1 for the file to load.
fields.evidence: FUN_080056a0 zeroes the u16 at footer+0x14 (save offset 0x32C); FUN_08005178 (EEPROM block 99 = byte 0x318) and FUN_0801ea64 require *(short*)(buf+0x14) == 1.
fields.name: file_valid_flag

magic_signatures.description: ASCII 'GOEM': first 4 bytes of the ROM title string at save offset 0
